what_happened: Scene: layout 8, capsule machine CoffeeMachine102 (SINGLE/DOUBLE buttons on a round front face), red mug_5 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: first close on air 116, grasp 132 by the rim, mug under the spout by ~297, released 365 at 0.0144 m (0.0166 m 2 s later), upright; stage 0 complete 452. Stage 1: the gripper went round to the right side of the machine and approached the round face edge-on with open fingers (600-648); the button registered at 646. It then lingered at the button side, touching the machine on and off (690-795), before withdrawing; success 820. Stage 1 took 368 steps after stage 0 (typical median 31, p90 249) because of the lingering after the press, not a missed press.
self_recovery: none needed; the initial close on air at 116 was immediately followed by a successful grasp at 132.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 broke twice (603, 744) only because the gripper came back within 25 cm of the mug while working at the button (not a real undo). Slow stage 1 is the gripper-away clause after the press at 646.
